defects.title: Japan priced a competitive half-subsidy as a guaranteed flat 50% at rank 2
defects.evidence: jp_vipo_location_incentive encoded tier jp-flat-50 (rate 0.50, is_band_ceiling=False, no conditions, no cap) while its own citation reads 'a cash rebate of up to 50%'. The canonical record jp_film_incentive ('Japan Film Commission Location Incentive (JLOC)') classifies Japan's current large-scale location support as a competitive 1/2 subsidy capped at JPY1.5bn with fiscal-year criteria, discretion flags competitive=True, selective=True, headline_maximum_guaranteed=False. Same 50% figure, same scheme. It ranked #2 with a $2,027,098 incentive — 55% larger than any other candidate.
defects.chain_fixed: canonical identity binding -> coverage registry (NON_GUARANTEED_SELECTIVE) -> discovery -> price_segment -> NPC -> ranking -> Bridge

defects.title: Kazakhstan priced a flat 30% from a single uncorroborated source
defects.evidence: kz_investment_subsidy citation reads 'mbrellafilms.com (single source, not further corroborated)'. The canonical adjudication for Kazakhstan (kz_film_incentive) is authority-insufficient on directly conflicting sources (30% case-by-case vs no incentive at all). Slug-spelling escape of the same program.
defects.chain_fixed: canonical identity binding -> coverage registry (UNPRICEABLE_AUTHORITY_INSUFFICIENT) -> discovery -> price_segment
